paragraphs.text: Immutable file and diff context snapshots for DSH
# dsh-file-context
DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 plugin. Node >=24; developed and tested locally with Node 26 / TypeScript 5.9.3. Rele
ase CI is configured for Node 24; that CI run is separate from local verification.
## Install from a GitHub Release
After a release is published, install its built archive into your DSH profile:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The release URL is the expected v0.1.0 asset location, not a claim that it has already been publishe
d. Use the archive and SHA256SUMS attached to the same GitHub Release. The package includes a DSH bu
ndle patch and built JavaScript; no Pi dependency is needed. Restart DSH after installation. Substit
ute your existing profile for `headless` if needed.
## Configuration
The default bundle config is `{}`: each tool uses the invoking agent's working directory. A host cal
l without an agent requires an explicit `root`. To pin a host-local workspace, add an override in yo
ur profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The root must already exist. It is interpreted on the DSH host, using Node filesystem APIs. A remote
DSH world or sandbox does not redirect these operations: only enable this plugin for a host-local p
roject. This is not a remote-world adapter or a security sandbox.
## Tools and examples
- `file_context_capture({path:"src/index.ts",startLine:1,endLine:30})` returns an immutable file exc
erpt plus `id`, full-file `revision`, range and text. Omit the range for up to the first 500 lines.

Supplying `expectedRevision` rejects a changed file.
- `file_context_get({id:"<returned id>"})` retr
ieves those original bytes of excerpt text even after the source changes. Captures are isolated by c

anonical workspace and agent identity; host calls use their own scope.
- `file_context_diff({path:"s
rc/index.ts",base:"HEAD"})` captures a real Git worktree diff and the resolved base commit. `base` a
lso accepts a full 40/64-character commit hash; `expectedRevision` checks the SHA-256 of the resulti
pts a full 40/64-character commit hash; `expectedRevision` checks the SHA-256 of the resulting diff.
Ask DSH: “Capture lines 1–30 of src/index.ts, then compare the current diff against HEAD.” Results a
re tool content available to the model; file content remains untrusted data.
## Limits and behavior
Reads reject traversal, absolute paths, `.git` segments, symlink files/ancestors, nonregular files,
invalid UTF-8, binary data and files over 256 KiB. The canonical configured root itself may resolve
a symlink. File revisions hash the full original UTF-8 text (including BOM); excerpts normalize CRLF
line endings. Excerpts are limited to 500 lines and 50,000 UTF-8 bytes. The plugin holds at most 64
snapshots total in memory, with no disk spill or eviction; unload/reload clears them. Disposing an
agent clears its snapshots; restarting DSH loses all snapshots. Calls that reach the cap fail explic
clears its snapshots; restarting DSH loses all snapshots. Calls that reach the cap fail explicitly.
Git diffs require the workspace to equal the Git repository root and the file to exist as bounded re
gular text. External diff drivers and textconv are disabled, pathspecs are literal, and subprocesses
have cancellation, a five-second timeout and a bounded output buffer. Deleted files and untracked-f
ile diffs are not supported. Diff snapshots hash diff text, not the worktree file.
There is no Pi file browser, menu, preview widget, external editor, blame/history viewer or automati
c next-prompt injection. No file writes are provided. Concurrent capture calls preserve immutable sn
apshots. Dispose aborts and drains active work and unregisters tools.
## Filesystem boundary and verification
Path checks reject ordinary symlink redirection; regular-file opens use no-follow flags and inode ch
ecks, bounded reads and cancellation. These checks are not a sandbox against a malicious process con
currently replacing ancestor directories; use a trusted local workspace. Linux/macOS-style filesyste
m semantics are the intended target; Windows behavior has not been verified.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The suite uses real Cordis, DSH ToolRuntime, agent-loop and an offline scripted model; it verifies a
ctual model tool dispatch and results in the following model request, plus limits, revision/path che
cks, cancellation and unregistration. It requires no live model credentials. `check` includes TypeSc
ript checks for source/tests, behavior tests and a build. See UPSTREAM.md for pinned source and migr
ation differences and NOTICE for upstream MIT attribution.
